evidence_basis: Aqeilan et al. 2007 Cancer Res 67:9330-9336 (PMID 17909041), publisher PDF supplied by the operator in this session (7 pages, SHA-256 be70d7bddc0db7e81241abe1ff29f81b6d562c20e5c9d38100eabdd061465db5, recomputed); abstract, introduction, Methods, Results, Table 1, Discussion read as text; figure legends read; Fig 4 (blots) page rendered and viewed (one wild-type MEF clone against three null clones; no quantification); Supplementary Figs S1 and S2 and Table S1 not supplied.

verbatim_locator | proposition: Wwox expression is positively associated with membranous ErbB4 and with overall ErbB4, not with nuclear ErbB4 | Results (Presence of Wwox is associated with ErbB4 localization) | "Immunohistochemical analyses indicated that Wwox expression was positively associated with ErbB4 localization at the cell membrane (P = 0.0003; Table 1). In contrast, no significant association was observed between Wwox expression and nuclear ErbB4 immunoreactivity (P = 0.82)"

verbatim_locator | proposition: loss of Wwox lowers full-length ErbB4 in MCF-7 and Wwox-null MEFs | Results (Expression of Wwox up-regulates) | "Transient expression of MCF-7 cells with siRNAs specifically targeting human Wwox mRNA resulted in reduced expression of full-length endogenous ErbB4 protein (Fig. 4B). Consistent with this finding, MEF clones established from null mice with targeted Wwox alleles showed less endogenous full-length ErbB4 expression when compared with MEFs isolated from wt littermate mice (Fig. 4C)"

verbatim_locator | proposition: soluble ErbB4 ICD coprecipitated with Wwox, data not shown | Results (Wwox binds both ErbB4 isoforms) | "In addition to full-length ErbB4, soluble ICD forms of ErbB4 coimmunoprecipitated with Wwox (data not shown)"
